title: Complete suffixed REAL64 radial-lane ownership and ABI blueprint

authority.purpose: Freeze the unique complete ownership and checked-interface design that can remove every mutable-state REAL32 round trip in the locked radial lane.

The unchanged scan then gives IGDEB=1 and initial NGEFF=370 without a threshold.

mcgfcf_to_mcgffir_keyflx_rank2.caller_guard: MCGFL164 proves NLF=NLIN=NFUNL=1 before entering MCGFCF because NFUNL is not present in the callback argument list.
mcgfcf_to_mcgffir_keyflx_rank2.parallel_safety: No SAVE, COMMON, module state, I/O or guard state; calls may occur inside the legacy MCGFCF OpenMP region.
mcgfcf_to_mcgffir_keyflx_rank2.numerical_work: None; the adapter forwards every non-KEYFLX dummy in the exact legacy MCGFFIR type, kind, order and explicit extent, and performs only the explicit rank normalization.
mcgfcf_to_mcgffir_keyflx_rank2.proof_boundary: A8 proves the external bridge object and its checked internal MCGFFIR call compile; it does not misrepresent legacy MCGFCF's implicit EXTERNAL callback as an explicit procedure interface.

conversion_ledger.replacement: For every physical group, require an exact type-2 record of length NUNKNO, read it into an explicit REAL32 group staging array, and promote elementwise into FLUX64(:,IG,2) during the unique entry event.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: FLU2DR REAL(FISOUR) fission-source accumulation
conversion_ledger.replacement: Before source construction, require every frozen MACRO0 NUSIGF payload to be finite numerical zero, then lexically omit the ON-arm fission loop and do not read CHI; no CHI*zero IEEE edge or live fission source remains.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: FLU2DR ITPIJ-dependent XSDIA self-scattering and live off-group XSCAT source products using REAL(2*IAL+1)
conversion_ledger.replacement: Lock ITPIJ=1 and skip the ITPIJ=2/4 XSDIA self-scattering-addition branch; after copying outer source slice 4 to inner source slice 8, evaluate only JG!=IG XSCAT products in REAL64 with exact promotion of the frozen REAL32 coefficient and integer factor before DOORFV64.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: DOORFV FUNKNO$USS type-2 flux reload
conversion_ledger.replacement: Require zero record length for every admitted group and perform no payload read.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: DOORFV SUNKNO/FUNKNO, MCCGF FUNKNO/SUNKNO, and MCGFLX FIMEM/QFR mutable REAL32 ABIs
conversion_ledger.replacement: Pass QFR_TAIL64 and PHIIN_TAIL64 through explicit checked REAL64 interfaces from DOORFV64 through MCCGF64 and MCGFLX64; no implicit legacy-kind boundary is retained.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: DOORFV REAL32 FGAR source/flux diagnostic capture
conversion_ledger.replacement: Use FGAR64(NREG) for IMPX>3 region source/flux formatting and print PHIIN_TAIL64(:,II) directly for IMPX>4 full-unknown output; no diagnostic assignment may round QFR_TAIL64 or PHIIN_TAIL64.

conversion_ledger.replacement: Assign TEMP64=EPS64(II), compare TEMP64>EPSI64, and print TEMP64 directly; the warning decision and diagnostic record never return to REAL32.

conversion_ledger.replacement: MCCGF64 owns REPS64 and EPS64, exactly promotes the frozen EPSI binary32 value once, and passes all three through checked REAL64 interfaces without changing the tolerance value.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: MCGFLX Richardson REAL(FLUX) updates and REAL32 norms
conversion_ledger.replacement: MCGFLX64 dispatches only to MCGMRE64.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: MCGMRE REAL(RHO/DENOM), REAL(FLOUT), REAL(V), and REAL(G*V)

conversion_ledger.replacement: Use checked REAL64 QN64, FI64 and FIOLD64 inputs; keep SC and XSCAT stored REAL32 and promote them exactly only where used by the REAL64 source or residual expression. The locked MACFLG=false branch does not consume XSCAT.

conversion_ledger.replacement: Use checked REAL64 PHIIN64 and pass EPSINTO64 unchanged through MCGFL164 EPSACC64 to MCGFCA64 EPSACA64; keep FLXN64, TEMP64, norms, AR and PSI REAL64, and pass FLXN64 unchanged as MCGABG64 FAC64.

conversion_ledger.replacement: Use checked REAL64 EPSM64 and FAC64 inputs, exactly promote the inherited EPSMAX bits, and evaluate RHSN, EPSINF, EPS2 and all four cutoff guards in REAL64.

conversion_ledger.legacy_location: FLUBAL REAL(XCSOU) and REAL32 rebalancing solve
conversion_ledger.replacement: Keep XCSOU64, matrix, right-hand side, solution and flux update REAL64.

conversion_ledger.replacement: Use FL_PRINT64(NREG), or print the indexed FLUX64 values directly, for IPRT>=3/4 diagnostics; this does not consume the single allowed type-2 terminal mirror.

conversion_ledger.replacement: Do not instantiate RKEFF in the first suffixed lane; the only later uses are guarded by ITYPEC>=2, which is outside the frozen branch.

conversion_ledger.replacement: Call the existing PRINDM with the REAL64 PHIIN_TAIL64/FIMEM view and KPN; the ON arm never calls PRINAM for mutable state and allocates no REAL32 print adapter.

conversion_ledger.replacement: No change; this is immutable transport-operator arithmetic, not mutable-state storage.

radial_lane_epoch.begins: Successful ON selection immediately before FLU2DR64 allocates its REAL64 state.
radial_lane_epoch.ends: After a normal complete accepted write sequence, or at pre-acceptance fail-closed destruction with no listed mutation; a post-acceptance write failure is not rolled back.

door_tail_epoch.begins: One admitted DOORFV64 visit after the active consecutive group tail is known.
door_tail_epoch.ends: Immediately after successful REAL64 output scatter or fail-closed destruction.

mccg_operator_epoch.begins: One admitted MCCGF64 visit after KPSYS, NGIND and ISCH identities are checked.
mccg_operator_epoch.ends: After MCGFLX64 and every live ACA operation return.

routine_scratch_epoch.begins: Entry to the owning suffixed routine.
routine_scratch_epoch.ends: Return from that same synchronous call.

audit_lifecycle.storage: Existing SAVE module flags, integer STATE-VECTOR and borrowed GANLIB handles only; no solver REAL state or operator array is stored.
audit_lifecycle.admission_delta_from_legacy_audit: Only the audit-only MAXOUT and ACCE identities change from the obsolete one-map capture constants to the already frozen solver values MAXOUT=500 and ACCE=(3,3); no solver input is changed.
ordered_on_hooks: FLUDRV calls SPOMOC_BEGIN64 after frozen FLU controls are known and before FLU2DR64 state mutation or tracking consumption.
FLU2DR64 calls SPOMOC_FLU_PATH exactly at the legacy direct-vector path check.
At the first eligible IT=1,JT=1 door visit, FLU2DR64 calls SPOMOC_FLU_CONTEXT and then SPOMOC_DOOR_BEGIN immediately before DOORFV64.
MCCGF64 calls SPOMOC_MCCGF_BEGIN once after exact group/geometry/control identities are known and before MCGFLX64.
MCGMRE64 calls SPOMOC_SET_ROLE immediately before every MCGFL164 response call using the unchanged role and iteration identities.
Every MCGFL164 call invokes SPOMOC_CAPTURE64 exactly at the legacy post-MCGFST, pre-ACA point; only active primary role 1 iteration 1 writes the tuple.
MCGMRE64 calls SPOMOC_PUBLISH immediately after the first primary MCGFL164 return.
FLUDRV calls SPOMOC_FINISH after the selected FLU2DR64 route returns.
audit_lifecycle.interpretation: This narrow pre-existing audit lifecycle exception does not weaken the prohibition on hidden mutable solver state, operator ownership or cutoff counters.

SC is gathered once by MCCGF64 and cannot be gathered downstream.
No mutable-state REAL32 conversion exists in the inner path.
Every admitted FUNKNO$USS record is absent before any payload read.
Only the KRYL=10 GMRES and one-group ACA branches are represented.
KEYFLX_BASE1, KEYFLX_TRK3, the direct KEYFLX_TRK3(:,1,:) rank-2 section and PJJIND_TRK2 compile with their frozen distinct ranks; sequence association and flat PJJIND are rejected.

The MCGFCF callback uses a global explicit-shape MCGFFIR64_RANK_ADAPTER and its direct KEYFLX_TRK3(:,:,1) rank-2 section; object and call-list checks enforce a checked internal MCGFFIR call, and negative checks reject descriptor-based callback ABIs or rank-3/flat sequence association into MCGFFIR.
The locked regular-tracking header proves NREG_TRACK=NBREG=N2REG=8, NSOU=N2SOU=NSOUT=6 and NFI=NLONG=K=KPN=NUNKNO=14 before MATALB payload consumption, and MATALB_TRK has exact bounds (-NSOUT:NREG).
CAZ0_INACTIVE64(NANGL) and XSI_INACTIVE64(NSOUT) are conforming defined REAL64 storage; negative checks reject XSIXYZ(:,0) or any invalid XSI actual, while exact stored CPO32(NMU) is preserved.
All live MCCGF tracking records XMU/WZMU/ZMU/V/NZON/KEYCUR and MCGSIG records ICODE/ALBEDO/DRAGON-TXSC pass exact LCMLEN type-and-extent admission before payload access.
BC-REFL+TRAN has exact length NLONG-NREG and GANLIB type 1 before mapping, and every active PJJ$MCCG has exact length NREG*NPJJM and GANLIB type 2 before MCGFST.

Frozen discrete values pass the existing capture-layout admission: PJJIND_TRK2(1,:)=[1,1], scalar/current keys form a duplicate-free permutation of 1..KPN, boundary and zone indexes are in range, and volume/operator payloads are finite with positive volume.
PACA=4 active CF$MCCG is mapped as CF32(LC), and negative compile contracts reject CF32(N1) whenever N1 differs from LC.
All nine active PACA=4 records IM/MCU/PI/JU/DIAGQ/CQ/ILUDF/CF/DIAGF pass exact LCMLEN type-and-extent admission before mapping to their frozen one-dimensional views.
DIAGF_INACTIVE32 is passed only to the direct pre-MCGABG MCGPRA64 call; MCGABG64 and its internal MCGPRA64 calls use active DIAGF32(N1).
PACA=4 uses local defined IM0_INACTIVE(1) and MCU0_INACTIVE(1) only with LC0=0 assumed-size inactive formals; no SAVE object or inactive-record mapping is allowed.
MCGPRA64 declares IM(NLONG+1), preserves arithmetic and calls MSRLUS1 conformingly; the ON arm contains no call to legacy MCGPRA.
PACA=4 inactive explicit-shape formals use conforming defined storage, and negative compile contracts reject one-element substitutes.
Exact integer(int64) cutoff deltas propagate from every MCGABG64 call to the DOORFV64 boundary without reset, overwrite or hidden shared state.
NCONV arbitrary non-contiguous masks remain supported inside the consecutive NGIND tail.
No object is linked to or executed as a transport program.

required_checks: Exactly one entry promotion and no pre-terminal REAL32 state round trip.

The admitted ON route calls unchanged XDRTA2 exactly once before the first MCGSCA use; static checks reject omission, duplication or a replacement exponential table.

FLUBAL64 receives only the direct KEYFLX, MATALB, SURFAC and FLUX64(:,:,7) sections plus exact read-only OFFGROUP32 rectangular dummies, performs no later off-group LCMGET, and FLU2AC64 receives only the direct inner or outer three-slice FLUX64/AKEEP64 sections; element-actual sequence association is rejected.

Every group NJJS00/IJJS00/IPOS00/SCAT00 record is admitted once with exact type, extent, index range and finite values into immutable OFFGROUP32, which both FLU2DR64 and FLUBAL64 reuse without later LCMGET.

FLU owns conforming KEYFLX_HOST3 rank-3 storage; KEYFLX_BASE1 and KEYFLX_TRK3(:,1,1) are the same admitted KEYFLX$ANIS values, MATCOD/NZON and VOLUME/V identities close, and layered CHILD_OK/DRIVER_OK/HOST_OK gates order FLU2DR64 publication, FLUDRV metadata, then FLU LINK.* and SPOT-LEAK1D writes.

After the strict terminal Boolean and before any accepted-block write, every authoritative REAL64 value is finite and every compatibility-mirror value satisfies abs(x)<=real(huge(0.0_real32),real64); this machine-representation preflight cannot change convergence.
OFF is default and ON cannot fall back.
